tiktok.caption:
I'm not lazy. I'm stuck at the start. 🫠

I'm not tired. I'm not lazy. I just can't make myself move. Once I start, I'm usually fine. Starting is the hard part.

So I told FOCO about it. It broke the video into four tiny steps. Step 1 was just importing the footage. Three minutes, something chill on, and now I'm editing.

Is starting the hardest part for you too? 👇
Save this for the next time you're stuck 📌

You don't need another to-do list. You need help starting. The app on the slides is FOCO, link in bio 💜
